title: Write a StatefulSet With Per-Pod Storage
intro: A Deployment's pods are interchangeable. A database's aren't — each replica needs its own identity and its own disk. That's what a StatefulSet's volumeClaimTemplates provide.

steps.prompt: Write a StatefulSet named 'db' with serviceName 'db', 3 replicas, selector/labels app: db, one container 'postgres' (image postgres:16) mounting a volume named 'data' at /var/lib/postgresql/data. Add a volumeClaimTemplate named 'data' requesting 10Gi with accessModes [ReadWriteOnce].
steps.hint: It looks like a Deployment plus two extras: spec.serviceName (the headless Service giving each pod a stable DNS name like db-0.db) and spec.volumeClaimTemplates (a list of PVC templates, each shaped like the PVC from yaml-005). The volumeMount name must match the template's metadata.name.
steps.solution:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: db
spec:
  serviceName: db
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: db
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: db
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: postgres
        image: postgres:16
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
  volumeClaimTemplates:
  - metadata:
      name: data
    spec:
      accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
      resources:
        requests:
          storage: 10Gi
steps.fake_output:
statefulset.apps/db created

$ kubectl get pvc
NAME        STATUS  CAPACITY
data-db-0   Bound   10Gi
data-db-1   Bound   10Gi
data-db-2   Bound   10Gi
steps.explanation: Three pods (db-0, db-1, db-2), each with its own automatically-created PVC that follows it across restarts and rescheduling.
steps.why: Putting a normal PVC in a Deployment with 3 replicas would make all three share ONE ReadWriteOnce volume — which fails to schedule, or corrupts data if it somehow doesn't. volumeClaimTemplates give each replica its own disk. Note that deleting the StatefulSet does NOT delete these PVCs — deliberately, so a mistaken delete doesn't destroy database data.
